description: 自用發電設備登記廠商資料 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部能源署. 本辦公室依自用發電設備登記規則規定，辦理自用發電設備登記證核發、補發、變更等業務。 為推動政府多元化資料公開政策，配合各界資訊普及性需求，開放與民眾需求有關之「自用發電設備登記廠商資料」資料集。 本項資料可提供一般民眾作為評量及參考的數據，資料集內容包括廠商名稱、廠商所在縣市、發電容量用途、登記證號等項目欄位資料，歡迎有需要的民眾下載使用... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部能源署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-13 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
